data.title: 椎名真由理 · MayQueen餐台前的嘟嘟噜爱心
data.description: 秋叶原MayQueen女仆咖啡厅温馨木质吧台前，真由理端着绘有番茄酱爱心的蛋包饭，歪头轻眨单眼展露招牌微笑，猫耳发箍在暖色调吊灯下格外俏皮。
data.location: cozy vintage maid cafe counter adorned with lace placemats and floral teacups
data.action: holding a plate of omurice with ketchup heart, tilting head with cute wink and cheerful welcoming pose
data.lighting: 复古咖啡馆暖金吊灯与桌上小台灯
data.promptProse: Mayuri presents a fluffy omurice decorated with a ketchup heart at the maid cafe counter, tilting her head with a sunny, cheerful wink.
data.animaCaption: Warm chandelier light glistens on the freshly served omurice as she greets customers happily.
